report_markdown:
## Executive Summary

- OpenAI introduced three new real-time audio models for AI agents: GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper.
- OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot, dated July 23, 2026.
- OpenAI announced that premium seats are coming to ChatGPT Business, dated August 10, 2026.
- OpenAI announced improvements to GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT and expanded access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users, dated August 6, 2026.
- OpenAI listed Spend Controls as a product release dated June 26, 2026.
- On June 3, 2026, OpenAI announced it is winding down the Agent Builder and Evals products, which will no longer be available on the OpenAI platform from November 30, 2026 onward.
- OpenAI recommends the Agents SDK for workflows that should continue as code and Workspace Agents in ChatGPT for use cases better suited to natural language prompting.
- On April 2, 2026, OpenAI moved Codex to token-based credit billing on a rolling 5-hour window.
- On April 21, 2026, GPT Image 2 arrived, giving Codex native image generation inside the harness.
- Codex now generates 2-4 different implementation approaches for a task and lets the user pick which one to execute, via a preview system.
- As of June 2026, Codex became the primary AI tool for every department at OpenAI.
- Among active internal users at OpenAI, Research saw the biggest jump in Codex usage: by June 2026, median use was 56 times higher than in November 2025.
- OpenAI's own estimate of power-user spend under Codex's new token-based credit billing is roughly $100–200 per developer per month.
- Accenture Federal Services and OpenAI announced a strategic collaboration to help U.S. federal agencies rapidly adopt, migrate, and scale advanced AI.
- As a key OpenAI Partner, Accenture Federal will help clients move from experimentation to production-ready, mission-grade deployment in weeks, not years.
- OpenAI announced the OpenAI Partner Network on June 14, its first formal partner program designed to help partners build, sell, and deliver AI solutions powered by OpenAI technology.
- OpenAI is investing $150 million to support the ecosystem and help partners bring the benefits of AI to more organizations more quickly.
- OpenAI will continue supporting voice customers with access to frontier models through the OpenAI API.
- OpenAI announced OpenAI Presence on July 22, 2026, as a governed enterprise agent platform.
- OpenAI Presence handles customer support, outbound sales, and high-risk internal workflows such as end-to-end billing resolution.
- Each OpenAI Presence deployment starts scoped to one job, and the customer company sets policy for agent autonomy, approvals, and human takeover.
- OpenAI introduced GPT-Live, a new generation of voice models for natural human-AI interaction, now powering ChatGPT Voice.
- OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, a next-generation model with stronger capabilities in coding, science, and cybersecurity, paired with its most advanced safety stack.
- OpenAI launched Rosalind Biodefense to strengthen societal resilience with biodefense.
- Between November 2025 and June 2026, internal Codex use at OpenAI rose 32 times in Customer Support, 27 times in Engineering, and 13 times in Legal.
- OpenAI's Operator agent was deprecated, with a shutdown date and rationale provided in an OpenAI deprecation notice.
- TechRadar reported that OpenAI's roadmap includes AI research interns by 2026 and full-blown AGI researchers by 2028.
- OpenAI published the Frontier Governance Framework on May 28, 2026, explaining how its safety and security practices align with emerging legal requirements.
- OpenAI's Frontier Governance Framework aligns with California's Transparency in Frontier AI Act and the EU AI Act's Code of Practice for General Purpose AI.
- OpenAI released the GPT-5.6 model family and GPT-Live, a new framework for voice interaction.
- The GPT-5.6 release introduces three distinct capability tiers: Sol, Terra, and Luna.
- Sol is engineered for complex tasks requiring high-level coding, cybersecurity, and scientific reasoning; Terra is balanced for everyday professional workflows; Luna is optimized for fast, cost-efficient workflows.
- Performance metrics indicate that Sol is at least on par with Anthropic's Fable 5.

## Findings

### New voice and real-time audio models

OpenAI introduced three real-time audio models for AI agents: **GPT-Realtime-2**, **GPT-Realtime-Translate**, and **GPT-Realtime-Whisper**. Separately, OpenAI introduced **GPT-Live**, a new generation of voice models for natural human-AI interaction, now powering ChatGPT Voice; it is described as a new framework for voice interaction. OpenAI will continue supporting voice customers with access to frontier models through the OpenAI API.
